name: lee-pos
description: Lee retail point of sale monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lee/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @lee/shared" "npm run dev -w @lee/api" "npm run dev -w @lee/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lee/shared && npm run build -w @lee/api && npm run build -w @lee/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lee/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lee/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @lee/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @lee/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run env:init && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:browser -w @lee/api
